established_contexts: Frozen hill_crest/u_turn/other_vehicle is source planning context, not physical proof of the generated grade, actual reversal or visibility.

variable_parameters.name: turn_to_opposite_direction
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: original observed body/heading episode, unknown until capture

variable_parameters.name: curve_or_crest_geometry
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: generated straight/curved plan-view road and shallow/steep grade readback

variable_parameters.name: two_direction_500ft_visibility
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: original body rays and independently reviewed pixels at both roadway approaches

variable_parameters.name: commanded_turn_path
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: authored three-point or stop-before-crest path request; no observed maneuver guaranteed

variable_parameters.name: grade_height_m
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: authored 0.8 m or 12 m quadratic crest height at the same station

variable_parameters.name: plan_view_curvature_1pm
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: zero on straight crest or reciprocal of authored 300 m circular curve radius
